description: This file defines the AutoFilter class for reading and processing auto filter configurations in XLSX spreadsheet files, specific to the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Handles reading and applying auto filter settings from an Excel sheet XML representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes AutoFilter with parent worksheet or table and associated XML data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads auto filter configuration from the worksheet XML, parsing and applying filter rules.

methods.name: readAutoFilter
methods.description: Reads auto filter definitions from XML for a specific range and applies rules.

methods.name: readDateRangeAutoFilter
methods.description: Reads date grouping filter rules from XML and creates corresponding filter rules.

methods.name: readCustomAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes custom filter rules and applies appropriate filter types and rules.

methods.name: readDynamicAutoFilter
methods.description: Reads dynamic filter rules such as 'today' or 'last week' and applies rules.

methods.name: readTopTenAutoFilter
methods.description: Reads top ten or bottom ten filter rules from XML and applies to columns.
